sortieMusters.line: ⚔️ SORTIE — Brian, Boris take up arms and a day's rations (4,470 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
⚔️ SORTIE — Morris, Brian, Chantal take up arms and a day's rations (4,700 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
